Name: Solaire of Astora - English Translation and SVE Compatibility Patch
Author: CozyPsychologist
Description:
[center][size=5][b][u]Solaire of Astora - English Translation & SVE Compatibility Patch[/u][/b][/size][/center]
[left][/left]
[left][size=4]Praise the sun![/size][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][size=4]This patch provides an English translation and Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE) compatibility for the original Solaire of Astora mod - you can find it [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27782]Here[/url]

Enjoy Solaire's dialogue, heart events, romance, and marriage content in English, with adjustments that allow him to better integrate into the expanded world of Stardew Valley.

[b]**This is a standalone compatibility patch. It does nothing on its own. You must install the original Solaire of Astora mod separately.**[/b][/size][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][heading][size=5][b][u]Features[/u][/b][/size][/heading]
[size=4]
Translates the original mod's existing content into English, including:[/size]

[list]
[*][size=4]Daily and friendship dialogue[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Heart events and story dialogue[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Romance and marriage dialogue[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Festival conversations[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Mail and letters[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Gift and birthday reactions[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Movie theater dialogue[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Location names and other miscellaneous text[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4]Stardew Valley Expanded Compatibility[/size]

[size=4]Includes adjustments for players using Stardew Valley Expanded:

- Sunlight Altar Entrance: Adds an entrance in the SVE Secret Woods at tile 66,6 (Pictured)
- NPC Schedules: Adjusts Solaire's daily movements to accommodate SVE's expanded maps.
- Festival Compatibility: Updates Solaire's positions during certain festivals, including the Luau, Spirit's Eve, and Festival of Ice.
- Weather Schedules: Includes adjustments for rainy and green rain days.

**SVE-specific changes are applied conditionally. **You do not need SVE to use the English translation.**[/size]

[size=5][b][u]Requirements[/u][/b][/size][size=4]

- Stardew Valley 1.6
- SMAPI
- Content Patcher
- Original Solaire of Astora mod
- Stardew Valley Expanded (optional)[/size][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][size=5][b][u]Installation[/u][/b][/size][size=4]

1. Download and install the original Solaire of Astora mod.
2. Download this English Translation & SVE Compatibility Patch.
3. Extract the patch into your Stardew Valley `Mods` folder.
4. Keep the original mod and this patch installed as separate folders.
5. Launch the game through SMAPI.[/size][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][size=5][b][u]Compatibility Notes[/u][/b][/size][size=4]

- Designed for Stardew Valley 1.6.
- SVE compatibility changes activate only when Stardew Valley Expanded is detected.
- Does not replace the original mod's character assets, portraits, sprites, or maps.
- Does not add new quests, items, weapons, heart events, or story chapters.[/size][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][size=5][b][u]Credits[/u][/b][/size][size=4]

Original Solaire of Astora mod: All credit for Solaire, his story, artwork, dialogue, events, and original implementation belongs to the original mod creator D0UDZ

This patch is intended to supplement the original creator's work, not replace or redistribute it.

If you enjoy Solaire's adventures in Stardew Valley, please visit the original mod page and show the creator your support.[/size][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][size=4]You can download it [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27782]Here[/url][/size][/left]
[left][/left]
